results.title: Visits to Australia and New Zealand affirm Viet Nam’s growing standing
results.description: A Russian expert emphasised that the visits reaffirm Viet Nam’s consistent pursuit of a foreign policy for peace, cooperation and development, while expanding trade relations and working towards shared prosperity. According to the expert, Viet Nam is increasingly being recognised as an important partner in regional and international cooperation mechanisms. Vietnamese top leader to pay state visits to Australia and New Zealand Foreign ministry facilitates business ties with Australia, New Zealand Viet Nam strengthens practical cooperation with New Zealand, Australia

results.title: Jharkhand Student Protesters' Second Round Of Meeting With Govt Delegation Today; What To Expect
results.description: Jharkhand Students Protest An eight-member student delegation in Jharkhand is holding a second meeting with the state government today regarding JPSC and JSSC exam demands They seek exam cancellations and a CBI probe into irregularities warning of continued protests if demands are not met by August 10
